20261122-chemistry-g02-1.material: [E2 Baaritaanka Kiimikada] Su'aasha mugga gaaska ee ku saabsan Budo iyo isku-dar. Markay tahay $25^\circ\text{C}$ iyo $1\text{ atm}$, mugga molar ee gaasku waa $24.5\text{ L/mol}$. Isla xaaladahaas, waa maxay mugga $\text{L}$ ee $0.2\text{ mol}$ ee gaaskan?
20261122-chemistry-g02-1.s.s1.prompt: [E2 Baaritaanka Kiimikada] Su'aasha mugga gaaska ee ku saabsan Budo iyo isku-dar. Markay tahay $25^\circ\text{C}$ iyo $1\text{ atm}$, mugga molar ee gaasku waa $24.5\text{ L/mol}$. Isla xaaladahaas, waa maxay mugga $\text{L}$ ee $0.2\text{ mol}$ ee gaaskan?
20261122-chemistry-g02-1.s.s1.explain:
Tallaabada 1: Marka loo eego sharciga Avogadro, mugga $V = n \times V_m$.
Tallaabada 2: $V = 0.2\text{ mol} \times 24.5\text{ L/mol}$.
Tallaabada 3: Xisaabintu waxay bixinaysaa $V = 4.90\text{ L}$.
20261122-chemistry-g02-1.s.s1.hint.0: Muggu wuxuu si toos ah ugu dhigmaa tirada moolasha.

20261122-chemistry-g02-2.title: Budo iyo isku-dar
20261122-chemistry-g02-2.goal: Codso mabaadi'da Budo iyo isku-dar si aad u xalliso dhibaatada baaritaanka.
20261122-chemistry-g02-2.material: [E2 Baaritaanka Kiimikada (Sare)] Dhibaatada falanqaynta qiyaasta ee ku saabsan Budo iyo isku-dar. Xalka aashitada $A$ wuxuu leeyahay $[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-3}\text{ M}$ xalka $B$-na wuxuu leeyahay $[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-5}\text{ M}$. Immisa jeer ayaa fiirsashada ion hydrogen ee $A$ ka weyn tahay $B$?
20261122-chemistry-g02-2.s.s1.prompt: [E2 Baaritaanka Kiimikada (Sare)] Dhibaatada falanqaynta qiyaasta ee ku saabsan Budo iyo isku-dar. Xalka aashitada $A$ wuxuu leeyahay $[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-3}\text{ M}$ xalka $B$-na wuxuu leeyahay $[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-5}\text{ M}$. Immisa jeer ayaa fiirsashada ion hydrogen ee $A$ ka weyn tahay $B$?
20261122-chemistry-g02-2.s.s1.explain:
Tallaabada 1: $[\text{H}^+]_A = 10^{-3}\text{ M}$, $[\text{H}^+]_B = 10^{-5}\text{ M}$.
Tallaabada 2: Saamiga $\frac{1.0 \times 10^{-3}}{1.0 \times 10^{-5}} = 10^2 = 100$.
Tallaabada 3: Fiirsashada $A$ waa 100 jeer ka weyn tan $B$.
